            <!--

            menu_num = 0;

            var menu0 = new Array();
            menu0[0] = "學士班";
            menu0[1] = "碩博士班";
            menu0[2] = "碩士專班";
            menu0[3] = "二年制專班";

            var menu1 = new Array();
            menu1[0] = "文、理學院";
            menu1[1] = "工、社科學院";
            menu1[2] = "管理、海科院";

            menu_left  = 10;
            menu_top   = 50;
            item_width = 100;

            item_color = "#E2E2E2";
            item_over_color = "#20B9B1";

            write_menu(menu0);
            write_menu(menu1);


            function show_menu(menu_no) {
                for (i = 0; i < menu_num; i++) {
                    if (("menu"+i) == menu_no) { document.all["menu"+i].style.dispaly = ""; }
                    else { document.all["menu"+i].style.display = "none"; }
                }
            }

            function hide_all() {
                for (i = 0; i < menu_num; i++) { document.all['menu'+i].style.display = "none"; }
            }

            function write_item(myitem) {
                var cont = '<tr><a href="">'+'<td width="100%" bgcolor="#e2e2e2" onmouseout="this.style.backgroundcolor=\''
                         + item_color + ' \' ; this.style.color=\'black\'" onmouseover="this.style.bachgroudcolor=\''
                         + item_over_color + ' \' ;this.style.color=\'#ffffff\'">';

                cont += myitem;
                cont += ' </TD></A></TR>';

                document.write(cont);
            }

            function write_head(a) {
                var true_left = menu_left + menu_num * (item_width + 5);
                var cont = '<div id=' + a + ' style="cursor:hand; position:absolute;display:none;top:'
                         + menu_top + ' ;left:' + true_left + '">' + '<table border="1" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0" >';

                document.write(cont);
            }

            function write_tail() { var cont = '</table></div>'; document.write(cont); }

            function write_menu(mymenu) {
                self_id = "menu" + menu_num;
                write_head(self_id);

                for (i = 0;i < mymenu.length; i++) { write_item(mymenu[i]); }

                write_tail();
                menu_num++;
            }  

            function copyid() { document.f1.ID.value = document.f1.IDtmp.value; }
            function copypw() { document.f1.passwd.value = document.f1.passwdtmp.value; }

            function chk_key1() {
                var c; 
                c = event.keyCode;
                if (c == 13) { event.keyCode = 0; f1.passwdtmp.focus(); }
            }

            // function chk_key2() {
            //     var c; 
            //     c = event.keyCode;
            //     if(c == 13) { event.keyCode= 0; f1_submit(); } 
            // }

            function chk_key2() {
                var c; 
                c = event.keyCode;
                if(c == 13) { event.keyCode= 0; f1.ValidCode.focus(); } 
            }

            function chk_key3() {
                var c; 
                c = event.keyCode;
                if(c == 13) { event.keyCode= 0; f1_submit(); } 
            }

            function f1_submit() {
            	  if (FrontPage_Form1_Validator(f1) == true ) {
                    copyid(); copypw(); f1.submit();
                }
            }

            function FrontPage_Form1_Validator(theForm) {
                if (theForm.IDtmp.value == "") {
                    alert("學號必須為七位阿拉伯數字 !! 請重新輸入");
                    theForm.stuid.focus();
                    return (false);
                }

                if ((theForm.IDtmp.value.length > 10)) {
                    alert("帳號必須少於等於10位阿拉伯數字 !! 請重新輸入");
                    theForm.stuid.focus();
                    return (false);
                }

                var checkOK = "0123456789";
                var checkStr = theForm.IDtmp.value;
                var allValid = true;
                var decPoints = 0;
                var allNum = "";

                for (i = 5; i < checkStr.length; i++) {
                    ch = checkStr.charAt(i);
                    for (j = 0; j < checkOK.length; j++) {
                        if (ch == checkOK.charAt(j)) { break; }
                    }

                    if (j == checkOK.length) { allValid = false; break; }
                    allNum += ch;
                }

                if (!allValid) {
                    alert("學號必須為7 或 10 位阿拉伯數字（或英文字母） !! 請重新輸入");
                    theForm.IDtmp.focus();
                    return (false);
                }

                if (theForm.passwdtmp.value == "") {
                    alert("密碼必須為阿拉伯數字（或英文字母） ！請重新輸入");
                    theForm.passwdtmp.focus();
                    return (false);
                }


                if (theForm.ValidCode.value == "") {
                    alert("驗證碼必須輸入!! \n Validation Code Needed.");
                    return (false);
                }

                if ((theForm.ValidCode.value.length < 4)) {
                    alert("驗證碼需4位阿拉伯數字 !! 請重新輸入 \n 4-digit Validation Code Needed.");
                    return (false);
                }  

                return (true);
            }

            -->
